title: CSCI 521 — Principles of Data Cleaning and Preparation
subject: Data Management
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the knowledge discovery process and explain how data cleaning serves as a foundational step for subsequent data mining.
Apply techniques for data extraction, cleaning, integration, and transformation across numeric, unstructured, text, and web data formats.
Evaluate ethical considerations in data preparation and mining, ensuring compliance with data integrity and privacy standards.
